  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The header comment of `_gh_final_stderr_excerpt` says it is only for the final-failure line of gh_retry, gh_retry_to_file and gh_api_json_to_file. The helper is now also used by the per-attempt warning lines (lines 1243, 1260, 1328, 1346, 1468) and by the two gh_api_retry give-up paths.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the stale comment could lead a maintainer to think the 2048-byte cap applies only to final-failure lines. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- tests/test_gh_retry_final_stderr_redaction.py:135-140 | severity=low | confidence=5

  WHY: It would not catch a forged workflow command such as `::warning::add-mask::x`. This affects test hardening only, and the NIT rating was unanimous.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:192 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `head -c 2048` in `_gh_final_stderr_excerpt` can split a multi-byte UTF-8 character just before the ` [truncated]` suffix.
  WHY: The effect is cosmetic only. This was raised as a hardening suggestion (risk score 1), not as a defect, and an optional `iconv -c` pipe would fix it.
